'''Lo'baan''' was an elderly [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who repaired ships in [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]]. Lo'baan was joined by the Twi'lek [[Seeker (Twi'lek)|Seeker]] who continued the business after he died.
